---
name: Feature proposal
about: Describe a concrete user need and a scoped change
labels: enhancement
---

## User need

Who is trying to do what, and what prevents it today? Include an existing flow or
example when possible, without customer data.

## Proposed result

Describe the observable behavior and how we could verify it. Distinguish a shared
Daedlo capability from application-specific model, adapter or fixture work.

## Scope and alternatives

What is the smallest useful change? Note compatibility, ownership or cleanup
constraints and any existing workaround. Link related issues if available.
